name: write_declaration_line
description: Writes the final, validated declaration line data to Odoo via a single RPC call. Must be called at most once per line, only after calculate_emissions has produced a result and check_consistency has raised no blocking issues. This is the only tool with write access to Odoo - the orchestrator has read-only access everywhere else in the loop. Call this as your last action once you have a complete, consistent result: the job is not considered done, and nothing is recorded anywhere, until this tool has actually been called. declaration_id/good_id/installation_id/quantity_tonnes/data_source are already fixed on this line (see the 'Known context' in your first message) and are supplied automatically - you do not need to (and should not try to) pass them yourself. Only supply the fields below that you actually determined: if data_source is 'actual' (see known context), supply direct_emissions_actual/indirect_emissions_actual from extract_field AND source_quote - the exact sentence those figures came from, copied verbatim; if data_source is 'default', supply emission_factor_id from lookup_default_value's result instead.

direct_emissions_actual.description: Only when this line's data_source is 'actual', from extract_field.

indirect_emissions_actual.description: Only when this line's data_source is 'actual', from extract_field.

source_quote.description: Required when this line's data_source is 'actual'. The exact sentence or phrase, copied verbatim from extract_field's document_text, that direct_emissions_actual/indirect_emissions_actual came from - not a paraphrase or summary. The write is rejected if this is missing or is not a real quote from a document you actually extracted.

emission_factor_id.description: Required when this line's data_source is 'default', from lookup_default_value's result. Must be omitted/null when data_source is 'actual'.
